name: MIXED FRUIT Jam
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Mix fruit Pulp (45%) (Apple, Banana, Orange, Papaya, Chikku, Strawberry), Thickener (INS 440), Acidity Regulator (INS 330 & INS 331(i)). CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL, NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (PINEAPPLE, RASPBERRY, BLACKCURRANT). CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (INS 150(d)) & SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR (INS 122). CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE (INS 202, INS 211)
